title: Water and Waste — Potable Water Tank — Installation of the 200 Litre Tank and Enlarged Feed Line
abstract: Retrofit of the 200 litre potable water tank and the enlarged feed line to the aft galley on ZEPHYR-24 aircraft flying long sectors, removing the need to carry bottled water to make up the shortfall.

sections.planning_reason: Operators putting ZEPHYR-24 aircraft onto six and seven hour sectors find the 130 litre potable water capacity insufficient for a full cabin with three lavatories and two galleys in service. The practical answer in the field is to load bottled water, which costs weight, cabin stowage and crew time, and several operators have had to restrict hot beverage service in the last hour of flight. The tank was sized for the original short-haul mission and was never revisited for the long-range variants.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the potable water tank with a 200 litre item carried on the existing seat track cover interface with two additional cradle straps into the frame, deletes the adjacent galley insert to release the volume, and renews the distribution panel with a larger bore feed to the aft galley.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Drain and disinfect the potable water system. Strip the aft lavatory and the mid galley locally to get access to zones 951, 971 and 181. Remove the existing tank and the obsolete galley insert HOL892964-82. Install the cradle strap brackets and secure with the tension head bolts EN594454-01. Install the 200 litre tank on the seat track cover interface D3810110221920 and torque the cradle straps in the sequence given. Install the distribution panel KAE623945-06 with the larger bore feed and re-route the line to the aft galley. Reposition the latch of FIN 17WM and the trim of FIN 299WM around the deeper tank and remove the trim of FIN 794WM. Fill the system, do a leak check at operating pressure and recalibrate the water quantity indication. Disinfect the system and take a water sample for analysis before the aircraft returns to service. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all ZEPHYR-24 aircraft, classic and Evo, that are not already at the 200 litre standard. Aircraft delivered after the production cut-in already carry the larger tank. The bulletin does not apply to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20 or ZEPHYR-22 aircraft, whose water system layout and mission profile do not justify the additional mass.
sections.material_note: Kit K3810-1019-01 contains the tank, the cradle brackets, the distribution panel and the line set for one aircraft. Lead time is sixteen weeks. The removed tank is not returned. Operators should plan the water sample analysis into the return-to-service schedule because the result is normally available only after 48 hours.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, normally alongside a scheduled potable water system disinfection.
